## Où j'en suis
Dashboards v2 (drag/resize grid, per-user layout persistence) is merged: #418 squash-merged as `4c0e9b3`. The two follow-ups from Priya's review — keyboard move/resize and a visible focus ring — are done on branch `tom/dashboard-keyboard` (commit `8f1a2c7`) and opened as PR #423, still open. `dashboards_v2` is on for zest-grocers on staging so Priya can rehearse the demo; production is untouched, Tom flips that flag himself on the morning of the 24th. No visx anywhere: #401 closed, all charts on recharts. (source: ses-db-4, ses-db-3)

- [en-cours] PR kestrel-analytics/platform#423 "Dashboards v2: keyboard move/resize + focus ring" open, not yet merged (source: ses-db-4, kestrel-analytics/platform#423)
- [prochaine-étape] Get #423 reviewed and merged (source: ses-db-4, kestrel-analytics/platform#423)
- [prochaine-étape] Zest demo Tuesday the 24th: staging flag already on for zest-grocers; Tom turns on the production flag himself that morning (source: ses-db-4, ses-db-2)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit KeyboardSensor on top of react-grid-layout: both libraries listen to the same pointer/key events, so every move was applied twice and mouse drags fired two layout changes; making them cooperate would mean rewriting the grid, so @dnd-kit/core was removed (source: ses-db-4, d4-02)
- [décision] Hand-rolled keyboard handler (useGridKeyboard) on top of the layout state, no dnd-kit (source: ses-db-4, d4-04)
- [décision] Keep recharts, close #401 for good — no two chart libraries (source: ses-db-3, c3-03, kestrel-analytics/platform#401)
- [décision] v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January, nothing removed now (source: ses-db-2, b2-04)
- [décision] ResizeObserver hook (useWidgetSize) instead of container queries (source: ses-db-2, b2-02)
